newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union up on repeated "buy".
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union up on repeated "buy".

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc were squeezed higher on Thursday on positive sentiment as broker BZW repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, traders said.
Commercial Union shares were 14-1/2p higher at 680-1/2 by 1040 GMT.
CU shares bounced back from Wednesday's close of 666p after the market felt the stock had sunk far enough relative to the sector, traders said.
"Buyers jumped in to squeeze the stock up this morning," one market-maker said. Trading volume was just under two million shares.
Meanwhile, BZW insurance analyst Angus Runciman said CU remained the "cheapest life stock in the sector" and that the share stands to benefit from its growing exposure to the European life market.
BZW's target price for the stock remains at 814p.
